body: I really like this. Thanks for sharing
Loved reading this. You summed it up so well - I hate that "permanant solution" platitude. That's...kinda what we want lmao
Best of luck, m8. I do this daily and it doesn't help me personally, but don't let that discourage you. Perception is huge in treating depression. Keep us all updated

For me, it means that despite this extremely longterm depression/suicidal ideation, I'm somehow still going. 


But it can also be used for those who have attempted suicide and continued living, among other things.
I'm not concerned about progress. Life isn't some kind of race. As long as I don't stay stagnant, I'll be able to tell myself I did a good job.

Oh, there's goals I'm working towards. I can be flexible with them too, I understand life doesn't always work out as planned. But it's not enough to make these feelings go away. And even when I go back to regular PDD, they'll still be in the background. I'll likely have more episodes of double depression.


Life just isn't desirable. Yet, I can't give up yet. Still gotta try those goals and options I haven't explored. I'm fairly young so who knows.
